I use simple analogies from baking and knitting to understand concepts—like how ratios in recipes or patterns in yarn help me grasp basic math ideas.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, especially when problems feel too abstract. My neuroticism score (92) makes me prone to stress, but I’ve learned to reframe anxiety as curiosity. For example, when stuck on a math problem, I take deep breaths and break it into smaller steps, like tackling a complex recipe.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried a free AI tool last month to help with basic algebra. It explained steps clearly but sometimes gave overly complex solutions. I found it useful for checking work but preferred human guidance for deeper understanding—like how a teacher might walk through a problem.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions by finding directions (principal components) that capture most variance.
